permissions.window.overlay: to draw the now-playing card and its play, skip and volume buttons above your panes

permissions.net:api.spotify.com: to ask Spotify what is playing, to read your playlists, and to play, pause, skip and change the volume

permissions.page: to play Spotify inside Tilefold, in a hidden page, and to show your playlists in a window of its own

permissions.script:sdk.scdn.co: to load Spotify's own player in that page

permissions.net:*.scdn.co: to show your playlists' cover pictures

permissions.net:*.spotifycdn.com: to show your playlists' cover pictures
